contracts: AgentProfile is initial simulation policy, not a continuously synchronized mirror of current authoritative DB character state. generate_profile derives AgentBuild role/activity_only from initial attributes/personality once; equipment style, skill specialties and quest propensity are coordinated initial decisions. bootstrap copies those initial attributes/skills/personality through actual configure reducer and retains original profile in final report. Later live personality, skills, condition and finances are read from public DB projections independently. A later deed or training does not require retroactively changing historical initial profile or static experiment policy. Public Serde/mutation can fabricate inconsistent profile but that is accepted-representation/admission scope; no ordinary stale live-build defect established.

Preferred activity is an intention chosen from personality plus RNG, deliberately not identical to build role. matched_activity_pair clones one generated profile then redistributes existing activity time and changes preferred activity, retaining the other initial facts. live_schedule quantizes to quarter-hours, removes inaccessible study/social/organization activities and transfers disabled crime into subsistence labor. This is realized reducer input derived from experiment intention; do not overwrite original preferred intent or require equal raw/quantized schedules. Medical rest uses zero planned activity; conditional provisioning policy can choose labor independently of static preferred activity.

LiveRunner maps are observer progress, previous values, event membership, decision attempts and experiment identity. Public diagnostic differential is an observer estimate, not private disease truth: confidence/newness and actual chart age choose an observation; medication scoring normalizes known likelihoods and estimates loss against canonical intervention effects. Condition readiness, observed symptoms, affordability and service availability are separate decision facts and are recomputed in current context. No second private disease state introduced by scoring or categorical confidence display.

Final reports fetch actual current character, clock, survival, money, condition and public diagnostic rows. Captured simulation-start baseline converts absolute clock to elapsed experiment time; max elapsed across agents is explicit report aggregate, not another strategic clock. Initial profiles and retained trace describe history, final_agents describe current observations. Event sequence may exceed bounded stored trace, so trace_truncated and total_event_count need not equal trace length; actual code computes that relationship rather than keeping competing counters with unrelated updates.

Config validation precedes connection and setup; reducer callbacks and public observation gates remain distinct stages. Callback success alone does not certify state convergence. Deployment host/database/nonce and optional world manifest identify requested deployment/artifact, while explicit note disclaims unavailable deployed module binary digest. Policy Seed controls profile/policy choices and server autoresolve seeds remain actual server values recorded from observations; these are distinct RNG authorities, not two seeds for the same operation.

Manual generated binding projections repeat canonical attribute/skill/personality rosters (15 attributes, 30 scalar skills plus religion/bestiary/language fields); these support existing F011 owner/codec consolidation, not a newly independent gameplay policy. Actual policy includes cooking/herbalism/surgery/smithing and terrain fields, preserving contrast with DB configure omission findings. Confidence thresholds and reserve choices are simulator decision policy, not duplicate clinical disease definitions to collapse. All original test fixtures remain independent observations/source-only, no new or executed assertions.
